recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 中，脂肪細胞周圍被一圈中型、核不規則深染的淋巴球緊密環繞（rimming），間質內並有核碎裂（karyorrhexis）碎屑與組織球，是皮下脂膜炎樣 T 細胞淋巴瘤的典型表現。
features: Atypical lymphoid cells rimming individual adipocytes
Small-to-medium cells with irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei
Scattered karyorrhectic nuclear debris and apoptotic bodies
Admixed histiocytes; infiltrate confined to fat lobules
describe_en: Sections of subcutaneous adipose tissue at high power show a dense infiltrate of small-to-medium atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei and pale cytoplasm. The atypical cells characteristically rim individual adipocytes. Scattered karyorrhectic debris and admixed histiocytes are present, while plasma cells are not conspicuous. Findings are consistent with subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma; confirmation with a CD8+, TCR-beta-F1+, cytotoxic (TIA-1/granzyme B) and TCR-gamma negative phenotype is recommended.

ddx.vs: Lupus panniculitis shows lymphoid follicles, abundant plasma cells, hyaline fat necrosis and mixed CD4/CD8 cells without cytologically atypical rimming CD8+ cells.
PCGD-TCL also rims fat but typically involves dermis and epidermis, is TCR-gamma positive, CD4/CD8 double negative, and has a worse prognosis.
NK/T-cell lymphoma shows angiocentric destruction and is EBER positive, whereas SPTCL is EBV negative.
